subject: Publisher onboarding: tenant evidence + manifest sanity checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@contoso.com>, marketplace-support@microsoft.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Publisher onboarding: tenant evidence + manifest sanity checklist

Hi Samir / Marketplace team,

Following our intake call this morning, attaching the tenant evidence PDF and a first-pass offer manifest for Contoso's SaaS listing. We want to get a short technical sanity pass from Marketplace so we can unblock the publisher account activation and SKU mapping.

Requests / asks:
- Can Marketplace confirm the identity proof steps (tenant proof + service principal) are sufficient for Contoso to be provisioned as a publisher? See contoso-tenant-evidence.pdf (attached).
- Quick sanity check on the draft-offer-manifest.json for schema issues (especially identityClaim and plan/sku fields).
- Any immediate blockers on the SKU entitlement mapping — Samir, can you confirm the three SKUs you plan to publish and the billing models? We attached sku-mapping-table.xlsx for reference.

Proposed timeline: if we can get feedback by EOD Monday (PST) we’ll finalize the manifest and request the publisher activation.

Notes: we plan to request co-sell enablement once the publisher account is active; Marissa will own the go-to-market checklist.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Partner Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments:
- contoso-tenant-evidence.pdf (tenant identity proof: admin consent screenshot + org ID)
- draft-offer-manifest.json (first-pass, includes three plans)
- sku-mapping-table.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir@contoso.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-support@microsoft.com, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: tenant evidence + manifest sanity checklist

Thanks Irene — got the attachments and the timeline. A couple quick clarifications from Contoso side: 

- SKUs: we'll publish Standard, Pro, and Enterprise. Standard/Pro are monthly subscriptions; Enterprise will be a "contact us" plan (metering handled via our billing portal). I've filled the sku-mapping-table with pricing tiers and SKUs.
- Service principal: we can generate the SP and give Redwood the contributor role scoped to the resource group used for the offer. Is that the expected pattern?

If Marketplace needs any additional identity proof beyond the PDF, let me know. We can have our infra team join a short session to create the SP while we’re on the call.

Samir
Samir Patel | Product & Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Industries

> Following our intake call this morning, attaching the tenant evidence PDF and a first-pass offer manifest for Contoso's SaaS listing. We want to get a short technical sanity pass from Marketplace so we can unblock the publisher account activation and SKU mapping.

From: marketplace-support@microsoft.com
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@contoso.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: tenant evidence + manifest sanity checklist

Hi Irene / Samir,

Thanks for the materials. Quick notes after an initial pass: 

- Tenant evidence: contoso-tenant-evidence.pdf looks acceptable for identity proof. We will still need the tenant ID (GUID) in a short signed statement from Contoso’s admin (simple one-line email from a verified admin is OK).
- Service principal: contributor scoped to the offer resource group is fine for publishing tasks, but for co-sell entitlement checks we recommend also granting the SP the Application Administrator role for identity claim tests during verification. Please avoid tenant-wide Global Admin if possible.
- Manifest: draft-offer-manifest.json has a minor schema issue in the plans block — the type field is missing for the Enterprise plan (should be "ContactSales" per the latest schema). Also the pricingModel field should be one of ["Monthly","Annual","Usage","ContactSales"]. We'll attach a short manifest lint report.

We’re attaching a short checklist and a sample statement template for the tenant ID confirmation. Please action the statement and the SP role update; once complete we can kick off a validation run and schedule a 30-minute verification call next week.

Thanks,
Marketplace Support Team
Microsoft Azure Marketplace
--
Attachments:
- marketplace-manifest-lint.txt (report)
- sample-tenant-statement-template.txt

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@contoso.com>, marketplace-support@microsoft.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher onboarding: tenant evidence + manifest sanity checklist

Thanks for the quick review and clear checklist. To summarize next steps and owners: 

- Samir / Contoso: send the signed tenant ID statement (uses template) and provision the service principal with Contributor + Application Administrator on the RG. Owner: Samir. Target: Mon Aug 17 EOD PST.
- Aditya (Redwood infra): I’ll coordinate with your team to run the validation once Contoso confirms the SP and tenant statement. Aditya, can you allocate 30 minutes on Tue Aug 18 to run the manifest lint and entitlement check?
- Marissa (Go-to-market): prepare the co-sell intake doc once we have publisher activation; include co-sell SKU mapping and sales plays.
- Marketplace Support: please confirm when the manifest lint is cleared we’ll be able to proceed to publisher account activation — link to docs or portal steps appreciated.

I’ll set a tentative 30-minute verification slot on Tue Aug 18 at 10:00 AM PST and share a calendar invitation; if Marketplace needs a different time please advise.

Thanks everyone — attaching the updated sku-mapping-table.xlsx with Samir’s pricing notes integrated.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Partner Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
--
Attachments:
- sku-mapping-table.xlsx (v2)
thread_notes: Timeline: aim to finish tenant statement + SP by Mon Aug 17; validation run Tue Aug 18. Owner matrix captured in final email.
